defensiveAbilities.name: Meltdown
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The irradiated undead plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by energy damage of any kind

Effect The energy acts as a catalyst for a nuclear reaction, causing the plant to explode and dealing 3d6 Poison Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:emanation with a Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Radioactive Remains
offensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn inside the aura is exposed to mild radiation.

offensiveAbilities.name: Seedpod
offensiveAbilities.description: When a irradiated undead plant Strikes a creature, some of its contaminated seeds stick to the target. The irradiated undead plant gains the Sprout action. An affected creature can remove this seedpod as an Interact action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sprout
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements One or more creatures within 60 feet of the irradiated undead plant are currently host to at least one seedpod

Effect The irradiated undead plant pulses with energy, causing the seedpods to sprout vines. Creatures hosting a seedpod must attempt a DC 16 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature takes 1d6 Piercing Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d6 Piercing Damage damage and is Slowed 2 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d6 Piercing Damage damage, is slowed 2 for 1 round, and is Immobilized until it Escapes. Until it Escapes, the creature is a new source of the irradiated undead plant's radioactive remains aura with a 5ft Type:emanation.
